execution.comment: KILL SWITCH: when false, adaptive management never creates pending exits, stop changes, or any economic action. Triggers/reassessment/validation continue unaffected. Enable only after explicit approval + fresh reassessment.

comment: Phase B1: position-contextual triggers. Price triggers are expressed in R units where 1R = (entry - original protective stop) / entry, from the frozen entry snapshot. No universal raw-percent threshold exists. Positions without a valid stop are R_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE and only horizon/observational triggers apply.

appreciation.rationale: fires when favorable excursion reaches 1R — the position has moved favorably by the amount originally risked. Conservative research default, configurable; not a universal return percentage.

peak_giveback.rationale: a real winner (peak >= 1R) surrendering >=50% of its favorable excursion. Both legs scale with the position's own risk unit.

adverse_acceleration.rationale: MAE beyond -1.25R = materially worse than the original authorized risk envelope

horizon_review.rationale: fires when an explicit date in the position's own reevaluation/horizon text is reached

catalyst.rationale: requires a news/event source not wired in Phase B; schema reserved, production disabled

debounce.rationale: one fire per family per ~2 sessions; re-arm only after the metric retreats 20% of the threshold value
